title: ChatContact/set + Message/set: non-object create/update silently no-ops
description: contact.rs:156-159 and message.rs:213-216 parse create/update maps with .and_then(|v| v.as_object()), which returns None for non-object non-null values (e.g. create: 42). RFC 8620 §5.3 requires invalidArguments in this case. A client sending create: 42 gets a silent no-op with no error. Compare: destroy is parsed correctly with explicit match arms. Fix: mirror the destroy parsing pattern.
